title: Check path-dependent references and round labels after relocation
problem: Moving a group of research files changes the base path used by relative links and can expose stale labels in neighboring records.
failure: After moving R09, its relative review link resolved to a missing root-level target. R18's markdown heading said R17 despite being the R18 record.
correction: Repair the R09 link to the actual Pascal-review record; correct the R18 heading label. Keep both original blob versions in Git history and state the two prose-only corrections in the route map.
transfer: Before finalizing a research-file move, scan all relative links from each new location, reconcile folder/filename/heading round IDs, compare blob hashes to separate pure moves from edits, and preserve provenance for every correction.
limits: These are two bounded defects observed in one relocation. The check does not replace subject review, certificate verification, or a separate freeze/provenance protocol.
author: TOTO; HORUS identified the broken link during review
